ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of low-intensity dark margins to high-intensity white central lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge; right lobe distal margin shows two significant irregular notches/indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the trailing edges, terminating in acute, slightly rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical line on the left lobe; multiple faint, unaligned diagonal scratches (rake marks) visible across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring and linear rake marks across ventral surfaces; irregular jagged edge loss on the distal portion of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark 'L-shaped' or vertical line pattern near the mid-distal region of the left lobe white field.
